# Tiny browser inference fixtures

`tiny-text-det.onnx`, `tiny-text-rec.onnx`, `tiny-formula-encoder.onnx`, and
`tiny-formula-decoder.onnx` are deterministic synthetic models generated by
`generate_tiny_models.py`. They contain no trained or third-party weights and
are distributed under the repository license.

The detector reduces a normalized RGB tensor to a probability map. The CTC
recognizer keeps a real input dependency and emits deterministic logits for
`AB`. Together they exercise model bytes, the in-memory resolver, Tract,
tensor execution, the OCR pipeline, `Document` AST construction, and browser
serialization.

The formula encoder and decoder keep real image and token dependencies while
emitting deterministic logits. Together with `tiny-formula-rec.json` and
`tiny-formula-tokenizer.json`, they exercise the handwriting readiness contract,
encoder/decoder loop, tokenizer, postprocessing, and `HandwritingBlock` AST path.
They are compatibility fixtures, not handwriting accuracy evidence.

Regenerate with Python 3, NumPy, and ONNX 1.19.1:

```text
python generate_tiny_models.py
```
